Name: Business checking
Notes: Settlements in, truck costs out, owner pay out by transfer

Name: Escrow receivable
Notes: Money the carrier holds back each week. Yours until the lease ends, so never an expense

Name: Freight revenue
Notes: Gross linehaul, fuel surcharge and accessorials from each settlement, before deductions

Name: Fuel
Notes: Fuel advances on the settlement and fuel you bought yourself. Keep the receipts for IFTA

Name: Repairs and tires
Notes: Shop bills and tires. A new engine or truck is equipment instead

Name: Insurance
Notes: Cargo, liability, bobtail and physical damage, whether deducted or paid direct

Name: Truck loan interest
Notes: Only the interest part of each truck payment. The principal reduces the loan

Name: Permits and licenses
Notes: Plates, IRP, permits and Form 2290 tax when it is paid

Name: Phone and ELD
Notes: Phone plan, ELD and load board apps

Name: Form 2290 savings
Notes: Weekly set-aside held by the carrier for the heavy vehicle use tax

Name: Truck and trailer
Notes: Purchase price of the truck. Your accountant works out depreciation

Name: Business credit card
Notes: One card for the truck. Paying it from checking is a transfer

Name: Truck loan
Notes: Loan balance. Should match the lender's statement each month

Name: Owner draws
Notes: What you pay yourself and any personal spending. Never an expense
